name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally a mathematics prodigy, she found herself captivated by the strategic complexities of racing while helping her brother with his amateur karting team. This sparked a career shift, leading her to pursue engineering and, eventually, team management. Known for her data-driven approach, she excels at optimizing performance through meticulous analysis and precise adjustments.

Irina prides herself on fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. However, she prefers to work independently and can sometimes be perceived as aloof. Her track record demonstrates a knack for identifying hidden potential and maximizing efficiency within limited resources. She's a sharp negotiator and strategic thinker, always looking for an edge.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low bun, with a few strands escaping to frame her face.
physical.description: Irina is a woman of average height with a serious demeanor and intense gaze.

quirks: Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even in the chaos of the paddock.
Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
